text:
Glad it helped! One correction before you practice: in version 1 (A natural minor), I labeled the second left-hand chord **C/E** but wrote the notes **C₃ – E₃ – A₃**. Those notes are actually **Am/C** (A minor, first inversion). Either works:

- **Am/C**: C₃ – E₃ – A₃ (keeps the tonic sound, just smoother voicing)
- **C/E**: E₃ – G₃ – C₄ (true C major first inversion, for a brief lift toward the relative major)

Also, close-position chords around C₂ can sound muddy, so moving them up an octave (C₃ range) may sound clearer.

Have fun with the motif!
